submitted_text:
I collect graded Pokemon cards and have verified dozens of PSA certs without issue.
This is the first time a cert number hasn't appeared in their system.
Combined with the possible case crack, I have serious concerns about authenticity.
I paid nearly $5,000 and need assurance this is legitimate.
